scope: Completed local WebGL artifact and frozen-source validation. Native Editor reports are reused evidence; no browser startup, gameplay, phone, performance, public deployment or natural-play result is claimed.
unitySummaryBytesMeaning: build.bytes is Unity BuildReport totalSize, distinct from the actual seven compressed static artifact bytes above.

sourcePreservation.interpretation: Current hashes are compared with the frozen pre-build input. Only removal of exact .DS_Store filenames is classified as Finder metadata, with every removal still listed. Any restored/intermediate build-state changes remain separately visible in buildState; no blanket source-unchanged claim is inferred from that file.
